comments_get_provider.description: Read the active site comments provider, readiness, revision and pending stored count. Existing stored comments remain recoverable when disabled.

search.keywords: comments provider built-in active readiness pending
queries: Where do my comments live?

comments_set_provider.description: Select built-in comments or disable public comments with null after a human confirmation card. Read comments_get_provider first for expectedRevision. Stored comments, settings and history are preserved.

metadata.title: Change the comments provider
metadata.summary: This changes the service that handles comments on this site.

search.keywords: comments provider select switch disable built-in
queries: Switch my comments provider.

comments_get_comment.description: Reads one comment by id in any moderation status, including approved, spam and trash. Call when a queue page does not contain the comment you need. Returns {comment} with the same moderation view and version as the queue. Unknown ids and denied comments.read permission are refused.

commentId.description: The comment's id. Get it from content_read.comment_moderation_queue's items[].id.

search.keywords: comment single details read approved spam trash id version

comments_list_moderation_queue.description: Lists comments filtered by moderation status (defaults to 'pending'), keyset-paginated. Read-only. Call this to find a comment's id and current version before approving, marking spam, trashing, or restoring it.

status.description: Filter by moderation status. Defaults to 'pending' if omitted.

limit.description: Max rows to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous call's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

search.keywords: comments waiting approval pending moderate moderation review queue unapproved held
queries: What comments are waiting for me to approve?
Show me the pending comments queue.
Are there any comments stuck in moderation right now?
I need the id of a comment before I can approve it.
Can you list comments that were marked as spam so I can review them?

comments_get_settings.description: Reads the workspace's 6 comments.* settings (enabled, requireModeration, maxDepth, closeAfterDays, spamAutoRejectScore, maxPerIpPerHour). Read-only.

search.keywords: comment settings configuration config current rules how comments work
queries: What are our current comment moderation settings?
Is comment approval required before comments show up?
What is the current per-visitor hourly comment limit?
What's our spam auto-reject threshold set to?
Are comments automatically closed after a configured number of days?

comments_update_settings.description: Updates one or more of the workspace's comments.* settings. A partial patch — omitted fields are left unchanged. At least one field must be supplied.

enabled.description: Master on/off switch for accepting new comments.

closeAfterDays.description: Close submissions on entries older than N days. null means never closes.

spamAutoRejectScore.description: Score threshold in [0,1] above which ingress auto-classifies a submission as spam.

maxPerIpPerHour.description: Max submissions per IP-hash per rolling hour (1-1000).

search.keywords: comment settings configure change require approval turn on off limit rate moderation rules
queries: Can you turn on comment moderation for the site?
I want to change how deep a nested reply thread can go.
Can you raise the spam score threshold for auto-rejecting comments?
How do I set comments to close automatically after 30 days?
Can you limit how many comments one IP can post per hour?

comments_approve_comment.description: Approves a pending (or previously spam/trashed) comment, making it publicly visible. Reversible via comments_mark_comment_spam, comments_trash_comment, or comments_restore_comment.

commentId.description: The comment's id. Get it from content_read.comment_moderation_queue's items[].id.

expectedVersion.description: The comment's current version (CommentRecord.version), for optimistic concurrency. Read it first; a stale value is rejected rather than overwriting.

note.description: Optional moderator note recorded in the append-only moderation log. Omit or pass null for none.

search.keywords: comment approve publish allow accept moderation
queries: Can you approve this comment so it shows up publicly?
This comment got flagged as spam but it's legit, can you approve it?
How do I let this pending comment through?
Can you make this comment visible to visitors?
I want to unhide a trashed comment by approving it.

comments_mark_comment_spam.description: Marks a comment as spam, hiding it from public view. Reversible via comments_approve_comment or comments_restore_comment.

commentId.description: The comment's id. Get it from content_read.comment_moderation_queue's items[].id.

expectedVersion.description: The comment's current version (CommentRecord.version), for optimistic concurrency. Read it first; a stale value is rejected rather than overwriting.

note.description: Optional moderator note recorded in the append-only moderation log. Omit or pass null for none.

queries: This comment looks like spam, can you hide it?

How do I mark a bad comment without deleting it permanently?

comments_trash_comment.description: Soft-deletes a comment (trash), hiding it from public view. This is NOT permanent — a trashed comment can be brought back with comments_restore_comment. For permanent removal, use comments_purge_comment if it is available to you; it waits for a human confirmation card. Otherwise link the human to /admin/trash.

commentId.description: The comment's id. Get it from content_read.comment_moderation_queue's items[].id.

expectedVersion.description: The comment's current version (CommentRecord.version), for optimistic concurrency. Read it first; a stale value is rejected rather than overwriting.

note.description: Optional moderator note recorded in the append-only moderation log. Omit or pass null for none.

comments_restore_comment.description: Restores a trashed or spam comment back to approved and publicly visible. The v1 restore ladder always targets 'approved', regardless of which status the comment was previously in.

commentId.description: The comment's id. Get it from content_read.comment_moderation_queue's items[].id.

note.description: Optional moderator note recorded in the append-only moderation log. Omit or pass null for none.
